subject: Pilot readiness and phased wave plan
messages:
From: Alisa Chen <alisa@elara-retail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo + pilot intake (traffic snapshot attached)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick response on the sign-up. We self-registered last week and poked around the hosted API. Before we lock a demo slot, two quick asks from our side so we can prepare:

- Primary use case: product search re-ranking + autocomplete (hybrid embeddings + generative fallback).
- Expected QPS: 120 read requests / second during peak, average 40 QPS. Concurrency: ~15 concurrent user sessions with 10–15 tokens per request on average.
- Timeline: pilot in July (2-week sandbox), production roll target in Q4.

Attaching a small usage snapshot and a proposed wave plan (CSV and XLSX). Can your SDR/solutions engineer confirm whether the metrics look feasible for a small pilot on Redwood Dedicated or Hosted?

Would appreciate a 30–45 min slot next week to walk through the architecture and pilot KPIs.

Thanks,
Alisa
Head of Search Engineering
Elara Retail
Attachments: elara_usage_snapshot.csv

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alisa Chen <alisa@elara-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo + pilot intake (traffic snapshot attached)

Hi Alisa — great context, and thanks for the attachments. A few follow-ups so we can tailor the demo and sizing recommendation:

1) Traffic shape: can you share the peak hour distribution vs. sustained hourly baseline? The CSV helps but a short note (e.g., "70% of daily traffic in 3 hours") is useful.
2) Request footprint: when you say "10–15 tokens per request," is that prompt tokens only or prompt+response?
3) SLA goals for pilot: is the goal functional validation (accuracy/quality) or also a latency SLO (e.g., 200ms p95)?
4) Data sensitivity: any PII in the inputs that would push you toward Dedicated or Private?

For scheduling: I can run the demo + quick capacity readout. Ben and Mina on solutions engineering will help with the wave plan and SSO/SSO provisioning check.

Proposed 30-minute slots (PST):
- Tue 24 Jun 09:00–09:30
- Wed 25 Jun 14:00–14:30
- Thu 26 Jun 11:00–11:30

Which works best? If you prefer, we can do a short pre-recorded walkthrough and use the live slot for an ops deep-dive.

Best,
Karthik
Sr. Solutions Partner
Redwood Inference

---
From: Alisa Chen <alisa@elara-retail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Jun 2025 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo + pilot intake (traffic snapshot attached)

Hi Karthik — thanks for the questions. Quick answers below:

1) Peak shape: roughly 60% of daily volume in a 4-hour peak window (US PST evening sales surge). Baseline during the rest of the day is ~25% of peak.
2) Tokens: 10–15 tokens is prompt only; generative fallback responses average 60–120 tokens when invoked.
3) Pilot SLAs: primary is functional/quality validation; acceptable p95 latency is <350ms during pilot but we'd like guidance on achievable p95 for production.
4) Data sensitivity: no customer PII in requests; product catalog IDs and aggregated behavioral signals only. Dedicated is preferred if costs align.

Slot: Wed 25 Jun 14:00 PST works for us. Please share a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Alisa

---
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Alisa Chen <alisa@elara-retail.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 07:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo + pilot intake (traffic snapshot attached)

Great — locking Wed 25 Jun 14:00 PST. Quick internal notes for the runbook and to confirm prep items:

- Action items for Elara before the call: share a single sample request/response pair (no PII) and the heavy 4-hour window start/end times in UTC.
- Our plan: 20-min walkthrough of Redwood Hosted vs Dedicated behavior for embeddings+rerank, followed by a 25-min sizing/operational Q&A.
- Sizing hypothesis: given 120 peak RPS and ~10 prompt tokens + occasional 100-token generative fallback at 10% invocation rate, we recommend a 4-GPU Dedicated pool for predictable p95 under 300–350ms. We'll validate in the session and provide a cost estimate afterward.
- Mina to confirm SSO, sample payload schema compatibility, and whether we can provide a short sandbox key ahead of time.

I'll create the calendar invite and drop the preliminary wave plan XLSX (attached).

Thanks,
Ben
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_waveplan.xlsx
